name: coworker
description: Delegate coding tasks from Codex to Claude Code, Codex workers, or Cursor and supervise them on a local kanban board with review and rework loops.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate coding work to other agents and track it on a local board
interface.longDescription: coworker keeps Codex as the main agent. Use it to dispatch implementation work to Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor workers, watch progress on a per-session kanban board, inspect the resulting diff, and send tasks back for fixes with review comments.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch this implementation to a worker and review the result when it finishes.
